# breadcrumb

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/breadcrumb"
```

Package breadcrumb is a path in one row, kv › app › prod, with a cursor on a part: left and right move it and enter chooses the path up to it. A path wider than its row gives way from the middle, as an ellipsis.

<a name="Chosen"></a>
## type [Chosen](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/breadcrumb/events.go#L5>)

Chosen is the event of a path chosen: enter, or a click on the part already under the cursor. Path runs from the first part to that one.

```go
type Chosen struct{ Path []string }
```

<a name="Keys"></a>
## type [Keys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.go#L25-L29>)

Keys are the bindings that move the cursor and choose. Each pair's second has no help of its own: the first names both.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Left, Right key.Binding
    Home, End   key.Binding
    Enter       key.Binding
}
```

<a name="DefaultKeys"></a>
### func [DefaultKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.go#L33>)

```go
func DefaultKeys() Keys
```

DefaultKeys are the arrows for a part, home/end for the first and last, and enter to choose.

<a name="VimKeys"></a>
### func [VimKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.go#L45>)

```go
func VimKeys() Keys
```

VimKeys are DefaultKeys with vim's letters added: h/l for a part and g/G for the first and last.


<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.go#L53-L59>)

Styles are how a breadcrumb paints its parts.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Part      lipgloss.Style // a part before the last
    Last      lipgloss.Style // where the path ends
    Cursor    lipgloss.Style // the part under the cursor, while focused
    Separator lipgloss.Style
    More      lipgloss.Style // the ellipsis for the parts left out
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.go#L63>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles mute the parts and separators before the last, bold the last and mark the cursor as the caret.
